text: Let's be honest: waiting 14 minutes for a build to finish is a productivity killer. That's why we decided to make the leap from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, and wow, did it pay off! Our builds now fly through in just 6 minutes, more than halving our wait times and keeping developers in the flow state they love. But the speed boost is only part of the story. Our monthly CI bill dropped from $900 to just $410, freeing up budget for the innovation that really matters! Best of all, the migration wasn't a headache. Over three exciting weeks, we moved 41 pipelines to GitHub Actions, carefully rebuilding each workflow to take full advantage of native integrations and modern tooling. Whether you're a platform engineer, a backend developer, or someone who just wants their code to ship faster, this journey has something for you. Grab a coffee (you'll have time to finish it now!) and let's dive into why we made the switch, what we learned along the way, and how you can supercharge your own CI pipelines today!
